reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that adds a persistent, theme-aware whale-dive animation beside the turn-status indicator, with reduced-motion fallback and no runtime network, storage, or user-content processing.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 的回合状态指示器添加支持主题和减少动态效果设置的循环鲸鱼潜水动画。
summaries.en: Adds a persistent, theme-aware looping whale-dive animation beside the DeepSeek Harness Web turn-status indicator.

capabilities: modifies the DeepSeek Harness Web turn-status UI with CSS
embeds and displays animated WebP and static PNG assets
responds to dark-theme and reduced-motion preferences
removes and reinstalls its owned style during activation and disposal
